R: Radius of curvature (mirror: positive when concave; refracting surface: positive when its center is on the far side)
d_i: Image distance (mirror: positive in front, negative behind; refracting surface: positive on the far side)
f: Focal length (positive for a concave mirror)
m: Lateral magnification (negative when the image is inverted)
n_1: Index of refraction on the object's side
n_2: Index of refraction on the far side
